---
title: "Overall survival with unrestricted follow-up — censoring diagnostics"
subtitle: "Reverse Kaplan–Meier curves and a frequentist censoring-hazard model"
format: html
---

- Censoring is the event; deaths are censored.
- Descriptive only: cannot show that censoring is independent of prognosis.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(survival)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(knitr)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "06-censoring", "results"
)
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Reversed survival data

```{r}
#| label: prepare-data
#| include: false

censoring_data <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
) |>
  transmute(
    tx,
    tx_plot = group_factor(tx),
    follow_up_days = survival_time_days_unrestricted,
    censoring_event = 1L - status_death_unrestricted
  )
```

## Reverse Kaplan–Meier estimates

```{r}
#| label: reverse-kaplan-meier
#| include: false

reverse_km_fit <- survfit2(
  Surv(follow_up_days, censoring_event) ~ tx_plot,
  data = censoring_data,
  conf.type = "log-log"
)
max_follow_up <- max(censoring_data$follow_up_days, na.rm = TRUE)
risk_times <- seq(0, max_follow_up, by = 100)

# theme = NULL: use the report theme instead of ggsurvfit's own.
reverse_km_plot <- ggsurvfit(reverse_km_fit, linewidth = 0.8, theme = NULL) +
  add_confidence_interval(alpha = 0.16) +
  scale_colour_group() +
  scale_fill_group() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = risk_times) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, max_follow_up), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Days since random selection",
    y = "Probability of remaining uncensored",
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  add_risktable(
    times = risk_times,
    risktable_stats = c("n.risk", "cum.event"),
    stats_label = list(n.risk = "At risk", cum.event = "Events")
  )

save_figure(
  ggsurvfit_build(reverse_km_plot),
  file.path(figure_dir, "reverse-kaplan-meier.png"),
  height = 6.5
)
```

## Cox model for the censoring hazard

```{r}
#| label: cox-model
#| include: false

censoring_cox_model <- coxph(
  Surv(follow_up_days, censoring_event) ~ tx,
  data = censoring_data,
  ties = "efron",
  x = TRUE,
  y = TRUE
)

log_hazard_ratio <- unname(coef(censoring_cox_model)[["tx"]])
standard_error <- sqrt(vcov(censoring_cox_model)["tx", "tx"])

cox_summary <- tibble(
  comparison = "ctDNA versus usual care",
  hazard_ratio = exp(log_hazard_ratio),
  conf_low = exp(log_hazard_ratio - qnorm(0.975) * standard_error),
  conf_high = exp(log_hazard_ratio + qnorm(0.975) * standard_error),
  p_value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(log_hazard_ratio / standard_error)),
  n_participants = nrow(censoring_data),
  n_censoring_events = sum(censoring_data$censoring_event)
)

proportional_hazards <- cox.zph(censoring_cox_model, transform = "km")
proportional_hazards_summary <- as.data.frame(proportional_hazards$table) |>
  rownames_to_column("term") |>
  as_tibble()

write_parquet(
  cox_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "censoring-cox-model.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  proportional_hazards_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "censoring-cox-ph-test.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-supporting-os-unrestricted-censoring-cox
#| tbl-cap: "Frequentist Cox model for the unrestricted censoring hazard"
#| echo: false

kable(cox_summary)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-supporting-os-unrestricted-censoring-ph-test
#| tbl-cap: "Proportional-hazards test for the censoring model"
#| echo: false

kable(proportional_hazards_summary)
```
